name: barbell sumo squat
description: A wide-stance squat with a barbell on your back. It hits the glutes and inner thighs along with the quads.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet well wider than your shoulders.
Turn your toes out about 30 degrees.
Brace your core and sit down between your legs.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Descend to thigh level or lower, then push through your heels to stand.
